name: Virgin Mama ~Musuko no Onedari o Kobamikirenai Cosplay Soukan~
original_name: ヴァージン・ママ ～息子のおねだりを拒みきれないコスプレ相姦～
source:
Growing up in a mother-son household, Tatsuo Kuma had a problem.
He had a crush on his mother, Misae.

"Geez, You've been cold to your mother for a while now, haven't you?"

"Come on, tell your mother. Who in the world do you fall in love with?"

Misae is young and innocent, so she is always open to skinship contact.
This was also a problem for Tatsuo.

One day, Tatsuo discovers an unfamiliar cardboard box in the closet of his house.
Inside were idol goods and photos, and upon closer inspection, he found that the faces were of.....

I wondered, "Could this ....be my mom, did she used to be an idol?"

To confirm that guess, I check the other photos.
I one picture caught my attention.

I looked at it and said, "What....is that me?"

The man in the picture with the idol is his father, holding Tatsuo when he was little.
But that would mean that Misae had given birth to Tatsuo during her idol career.

Then a thought occurred to me.
It was speculation.....that contained one hope for Tatsuo now as if the devil were tempting him.

"Could it be that.....me and my mom aren't related by blood.......?"
translation:
在母子家庭长大的隈研吾有一个问题。
他迷恋他的母亲美佐枝。

“哎呀，你已经对你妈妈冷淡了一段时间了，不是吗？”

“来吧，告诉你妈妈。你到底爱上了谁？”

美佐枝年轻天真，所以她总是对亲密接触持开放态度。
这也是辰雄的一个难题。

有一天，达雄在他家的衣柜里发现了一个陌生的纸板箱。
里面都是偶像的周边和照片，仔细一看，发现这些面孔都是……

我想，“这会不会是我妈妈，她以前是偶像吗？”

为了证实这个猜测，我检查了其他照片。
一张照片引起了我的注意。

我看着它，说道：“什么……那是我吗？”

照片中拿着偶像的人是他的父亲，小时候抱着达男。
但这意味着美佐枝是在她的偶像生涯中生下辰夫的。

然后我想到了一个想法。
这是猜测……对现在的达雄来说，就像是魔鬼在诱惑他一样，蕴藏着一丝希望。

“难道……我和我妈没有血缘关系……？”
